definitions.explanation: The failure to pay money owed, such as taxes, rent, or bills, by the due date. A formal/legal term often used in official and business contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{滞納|たいのう}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{税金|ぜいきん}→税金：03308_zeikin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{滞納|たいのう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{罰金|ばっきん}→罰金：18767_bakkin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: If you don't pay your taxes on time, you'll be fined.

examples.japanese: {滞納|たいのう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{停止|ていし}される→停止する：20992_teishisuru⟧⟦{可能性|かのうせい}→可能性：04818_kanousei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If non-payment continues, service may be suspended.

notes:
{滞納|たいのう} is a formal term for failing to pay bills, taxes, or other obligations on time.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{税金|ぜいきん}→税金：03308_zeikin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{滞納|たいのう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (fail to pay taxes)
- ⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{滞納|たいのう} (rent arrears)
- {滞納|たいのう}⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (delinquent payer)
- {滞納|たいのう}{金|きん} (overdue payment)
- {滞納|たいのう}⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧ (action for non-payment)

USAGE NOTE: A formal/legal term. In casual conversation, people might say ⟦{払|はら}っていない→払う：00535_harau⟧ (haven't paid) instead.
